chair_assembly_puzzle.name: Chair Assembly Puzzle
chair_assembly_puzzle.description: Interactive puzzle where players assemble a Judd-inspired chair by scaling, rotating, and positioning cube pieces to match ghost guides.

scalable_wood_cube.name: Scalable Wood Cube
scalable_wood_cube.description: Grabbable wood cube with two-handed scaling support. Scale snaps to discrete values (0.05x to 4.0x) per axis.

attachable_wood_cube.name: Attachable Wood Cube
attachable_wood_cube.description: Scalable wood cube with attachment points on all faces. Pieces snap together when attachment points align and face each other.

snappable_wood_cube.name: Snappable Wood Cube
snappable_wood_cube.description: Scalable wood cube with grid-based face snapping. Faces snap to 0.05m grid alignment when parallel and close.

stool_assembly_puzzle.name: Stool Assembly Puzzle
stool_assembly_puzzle.description: Assembly puzzle for a simple stool (seat + 4 legs).

table_assembly_puzzle.name: Table Assembly Puzzle
table_assembly_puzzle.description: Assembly puzzle for a minimal table (top + 4 legs).

shelf_assembly_puzzle.name: Shelf Assembly Puzzle
shelf_assembly_puzzle.description: Assembly puzzle for a Judd-style shelf (2 vertical supports + 3 horizontal shelves).

biederman_relief.name: Biederman Relief Puzzle
biederman_relief.description: Constructivist relief composition inspired by Charles Biederman. Arrange colored rectangular bars at varying depths on a blue backing.

mondrian_relief.name: Mondrian Relief Puzzle
mondrian_relief.description: De Stijl relief composition inspired by Piet Mondrian. Grid-based arrangement with primary colors and black lines.

albers_relief.name: Albers Relief Puzzle
albers_relief.description: Color study relief inspired by Josef Albers. Nested squares exploring color interaction.

constructivist_relief.name: Constructivist Relief Puzzle
constructivist_relief.description: Dynamic diagonal composition inspired by Soviet Constructivism. Bold red and black bars creating visual tension.

assembly_line_puzzle.name: Assembly Line Puzzle
assembly_line_puzzle.description: Conveyor belt puzzle. Build houses from cubes and pyramids on a production line.

lab_assembly_puzzle.name: Lab Assembly Puzzle
lab_assembly_puzzle.description: Half-Life inspired lab equipment assembly. Build health chargers, cameras, and specimen jars from basic shapes.

scientific_assembly_puzzle.name: Scientific Equipment Assembly
scientific_assembly_puzzle.description: Build real lab equipment from simple primitives. Assemble cubes and pyramids to produce a microscope, electronic scales, or multimeter.

score_display.name: Score Display
score_display.description: Visual counter display showing score. Can be incremented via signals or methods.

balance_puzzle.name: Balance Puzzle
balance_puzzle.description: Stack freely. Reach the height threshold while stable. Your creation transforms into a walking creature. No templates - truth emerges from physics.

equipment_assembly_puzzle.name: Equipment Assembly Puzzle
equipment_assembly_puzzle.description: Level 2 compositional assembly. Combine assembled equipment (microscope, scales, etc.) into functional workstations.

analysis_station_puzzle.name: Analysis Station Assembly
analysis_station_puzzle.description: Combine microscope, scales, and specimen jar into an analysis workstation for examining specimens.

measurement_station_puzzle.name: Measurement Station Assembly
measurement_station_puzzle.description: Combine multimeter and scales into a measurement workstation for precise readings.

storage_station_puzzle.name: Storage Station Assembly
storage_station_puzzle.description: Arrange multiple specimen jars into an organized storage workstation.

diagnostic_station_puzzle.name: Diagnostic Station Assembly
diagnostic_station_puzzle.description: Combine microscope and multimeter into a diagnostic workstation.

world_map_tablet.name: World Map Tablet
world_map_tablet.description: Metro-style map showing your learning journey. 6 colored lines represent QFEP layers. Stations unlock as you complete sequences.

audio_catalog_tablet.name: Audio Catalog Tablet
audio_catalog_tablet.description: Handheld sound library. Browse 73+ audio presets across 15 categories, preview sounds, edit parameters in VR.

artifact_catalog_kiosk.name: Artifact Catalog Kiosk
artifact_catalog_kiosk.description: VR kiosk for browsing and spawning artifacts. Filter by theme and complexity, search by tags. 318+ artifacts organized into 10 thematic categories. Dev tool that becomes player inventory through progression.

laser_exploding_sphere.name: Laser Exploding Sphere
laser_exploding_sphere.description: Grabbable sphere that explodes into particles when hit by a laser pointer. 40 particle burst with procedural explosion sound. VR target practice.
